title: Russia Aims to Inject Chaos Into Elections, U.S. Intelligence Finds

reports.title: Russia Aims to Inject Chaos Into Elections, U.S. Intelligence Finds

summary:
U.S. intelligence officials say the Russian government has again authorized covert online disinformation operations aimed at November’s midterm elections, seeking to weaken public trust and inflame domestic divisions. The classified assessments found no evidence that Russia tried to compromise voting machines or the actual vote count. Experts have recently identified social media campaigns using artificial intelligence to create fake videos of Hollywood celebrities discussing competitive Senate races. Officials said this operation appears smaller and less coordinated than some past Russian efforts, and Moscow is seen as more focused on presidential elections and distracted by the war in Ukraine.

The activity continues a pattern that U.S. spy agencies say has occurred in every federal election cycle since 2016. It comes as President Trump has repeatedly questioned election integrity, including a July address in which he claimed serious vulnerabilities in U.S. voting systems and accused officials of covering up foreign influence.
